Description

There is an abundance of gyms in London but Sidcup Leisure Centre, based in South East London, is an excellent one. The vast array of equipment to use makes it easy to train the entire body and means that you’re not lingering around in the gym waiting for the piece of equipment that you actually came to the gym for. The friendly and knowledgeable staff at Sidcup Leisure Centre makes joining easier as they not only know the best exercises for you to reach your goals but also like to get to know you and do their best to ensure you don’t injure yourself.

If public transport isn't your thing, then there are alternative travel options. The venue is easily accessible by car and free parking facilities are available on site. This also makes it the perfect facility for teams hosting home games, as it means the facility is extremely accommodating for travelling away team players.

It is worth noting that Sidcup Leisure Centre is only accessible to customers with a membership package. There are various membership options available depending on financial constraints and details are readily available from the facility. Do look at the T&C's to be clear on termination details and renewal dates.

For those who like the security of knowing you can play at the same time every week without fail, you can make a block booking at Sidcup Leisure Centre. This ensures you stay in the game and keep up your fitness on a regular basis. The very accommodating team at Playfinder will help you to secure your preferred slot or if that isn’t available, we will help you to secure the best alternative. A block booking is a booking made for a set number of consecutive weeks, on average this is 10 weeks.

If you're looking to travel using public transport, then the nearest station is Sidcup. This facility has excellent public transport links making it easy for all participants to reach the venue.
